query:
UPDATE factory_review_finding f
            SET kind = c.kind
            FROM UNNEST($3::int[], $4::int[], $5::text[]) AS c(seq, place, kind)
            WHERE f.run_id = $1
              AND f.round_seq = $2
              AND f.seq = c.seq
              AND f.place = c.place
              AND f.kind IS NULL
